scripts.postinstall: pnpm --dir client install && pnpm --dir server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --dir client dev" "pnpm --dir server dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir client build && pnpm --dir server build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir client lint && pnpm --dir server lint
scripts.test: pnpm --dir client test && pnpm --dir server test
